# Background {#sec-background}

 This post will be looking at time series analysis. Let me start by going over what is a time series analysis? "Time series forecasting, at its core, is the use of a model to predict future values based on previously observed values. It is used in a wide range of industries, including business, finance, and healthcare." (Fantasy Sports, 2023) So, the premise of time series analysis is looking at previous data points that happened in the past and use those to predict the future. Why is this important when you there is multiple other ways that you can use to predict a players performance? "Trends reflect the long-term movement in data. A team might be steadily improving or declining... One of the biggest advantages of time series analysis for match prediction is its ability to filter through the noise and emphasize repeatable patterns." (Underdog Chance, 2025) Time series analysis is good because it lets us see what looking at other data might not show us. You can make a player prediction based off of the conditions of the game a player is playing in, but that doesn't show that that player might be on a slow decline so there for you can easily overestimate that players performance. You can use time series analysis to compare player performance or team performance in past and use that to predict a game. I know on paper it doesn't seem that you can get a lot from a time series analysis but there are multiple different models for a times series analysis and you can get more information than you would think.

## The Research {#sec-TheResearch}

My goal with this paper is I want to compare some of my favorite Cowboy players that I grew up watching. I want to do this to find out, is the old Cowboys I remembers as good as I remember? When I mean old Cowboys that I grew up watching were players like Tony Romo, Dez Bryant, Amari Cooper, Cole Beasley, Jason Witten, and DeMarco Murray. I could go on because of how much I remember growing up watching these players and how I thought they were so cool, but were they as good as I remember.
I hypothesize that no matter how dear I hold these players to my heart they weren't as good as I remember. At most I presume they were probably above average when it comes to fantasy points and career stats.
